acceptance: 1) 通过HTTP以有效签名同意cookie分别发送page_view/product_view/model_view_start/model_load_success/model_load_failure/chat_start；逐项断言必填navigationId/viewId/productSlug、已发布产品白名单及strict长度边界。伪造/未发布产品、未知种类、超长字段、含敏感query的完整URL均拒绝，受拒事件行数不增加；每cookie第121个/分钟事件或IP-HMAC第301个/分钟事件按10节限流，429带Retry-After，受拒事件不落库；查询原始事件字段确认无原始IP、跨站指纹、email、聊天正文或敏感完整URL（E-47）。2) PostgreSQL重复eventId/semanticKey同载荷仅一行，异载荷409；同viewId success/failure只能一种终态，产品页事件与start/terminal分开存，failure不写success；-48h/+5min之外拒绝。3) 撤回cookie后请求403且事件行数不变；客户端模型生产者由M2-T7接入，浏览器同意及普通页面生产者由M5-T7接入。
en_accept: 1) Through HTTP with a valid signed-consent cookie, separately send page_view/product_view/model_view_start/model_load_success/model_load_failure/chat_start. Assert required navigationId/viewId/productSlug, the published-product allowlist and strict length boundaries individually. Reject forged/unpublished products, unknown kinds, oversized fields and full URLs with sensitive query parameters; rejected events do not increase the row count. Rate-limit the 121st event per cookie per minute or the 301st event per IP-HMAC per minute under section 10, returning 429 with Retry-After and persisting no rejected events. Query raw-event fields to verify no raw IP, cross-site fingerprint, email, chat body or sensitive full URL is stored (E-47). 2) PostgreSQL stores only one row for repeated eventId/semanticKey with the same payload and returns 409 for differing payloads. The same viewId has only one success/failure terminal; product-page events and start/terminal records are stored separately, and failure does not write success. Reject timestamps outside -48h/+5min. 3) After consent-cookie withdrawal, requests return 403 and event-row count does not change. M2-T7 wires the client model producer; M5-T7 wires browser consent and ordinary-page producers.

acceptance: 1) 用空白浏览器context点击footer analytics-preferences，断言偏好面板可见；在未选择及点击拒绝两种状态，cookie及浏览器存储无分析身份、POST /api/analytics/events次数为0，产品导航和模型操作控件仍可点击响应。点击同意后POST /api/analytics/consent的analytics=true，收到有效签名cookie；随后导航产生page_view，响应acceptedIds含本eventId，同navigationId重试后数据库仍仅一条（E-42）。2) 在事件发送前断网形成待发队列，再点击撤回：本地分析身份与待发条目数均为0，恢复网络后不发该队列；继续导航不发events，cookie已清，清cookie后无有效cookie的旧待发事件请求403。另延迟实际true请求响应后点击false，断言写请求串行、最后为false，全部响应结束后cookie为空、队列为0且不恢复采集，不补发撤回期间访问（E-43）。3) 1920×1080、1440×900、390×844记录请求及操作GIF；computed style的边界宽度=2px、圆角=0px、强调色等于11节token；Tab可聚焦各命名控件并以Enter/Space操作，每个触屏目标实测≥44 CSS px。4) 点击footer privacy-link→/[locale]/privacy，en定义文本包含“anonymous browsers that consented to analytics”，ru包含“анонимных браузеров, разрешивших аналитику”；文案不作唯一真人/跨设备识别宣称。隔离测试分别换设备context、清标识、换浏览器，查询后端确认可形成新browserHash，报告仅记不同与否、不输出原值（E-45）。5) 隐私页的必要聊天、分析同意、清理状态分区分别可见；期限显示来自配置的聊天cookie7天闲置/30天绝对、咨询90天、原始分析30天/聚合13个月，站点IANA文本等于SiteSetting值；默认清理状态明确显示未启用/dry-run及实际清理须另行授权，不把文档/派发视为授权；robots/noindex仍按既有完整度开关判定。
en_accept: 1) In a blank browser context click footer analytics-preferences and assert the preferences panel is visible. In both the unselected and Reject-clicked states, cookies/browser storage contain no analytics identity, the POST /api/analytics/events count is 0, and product navigation/model controls still respond to clicks. Clicking Allow sends analytics=true to POST /api/analytics/consent and receives a valid signed cookie. Subsequent navigation produces page_view with this eventId in response acceptedIds; retrying the same navigationId leaves exactly one database row (E-42). 2) Disconnect the network before event transmission to create a pending queue, then click Withdraw: local analytics identity and pending-item count both become 0, and reconnecting sends none of that queue. Further navigation sends no events; the cookie is cleared, and an old pending-event request without a valid cookie after clearing returns 403. Separately delay the actual true-request response, then click false; assert serialized writes with false last, and after all responses the cookie is absent, the queue is 0 and collection does not resume. Do not backfill withdrawn-period visits (E-43). 3) At 1920x1080, 1440x900 and 390x844 retain request/interaction GIFs. Computed border width equals 2px, border radius equals 0px and accent color equals the section 11 token. Tab focuses each named control, Enter/Space operates it and each measured touch target is at least 44 CSS px. 4) Click footer privacy-link to /[locale]/privacy. The en definition contains anonymous browsers that consented to analytics, and the ru definition contains анонимных браузеров, разрешивших аналитику. Copy makes no unique-real-person/cross-device-identification claim. Isolated tests separately change device contexts, clear identifiers and switch browsers; query the backend to verify a new browserHash can form while reporting only whether it differs, not its raw value (E-45). 5) Necessary-chat, analytics-consent and cleanup-state sections are each visible on the privacy page. Retention displays configuration values: chat cookie seven days idle/30 days absolute, consultation 90 days, raw analytics 30 days/aggregates 13 months; the site-IANA text equals SiteSetting. Default cleanup state explicitly shows disabled/dry-run and that actual cleanup requires separate authorization, without treating documents/dispatch as authorization. robots/noindex still follows the existing completeness switch.

acceptance: 1) composition只注册已实现analytics-aggregate，deploy/cron.nbshiyan每5分钟POST /api/admin/cron/operations；固定key/Bearer常量时间校验，未知key/无凭据拒绝，不允许任意脚本。2) 真调度在重启后实际运行并提交JobState/watermark，batch≤500、55s截止、旧代次不能覆盖；停cron/失败保持上次成功watermark并显示安全状态NEVER/FAILED/旧值，不凭路由存在或手动调用宣称刚更新（E-81、E-84）。3) 浏览器同意后同日同浏览器完成两次页面访问并刷新/重试同eventId，实际job后UV仍1、真实新访问PV增加且重复事件不增加（E-44）；看板GET不触发任务，通知/邮件由M4注册，不导入未来服务或登记空实现。4) 隔离服务使用可控时钟经事件HTTP入口分别提交now-48h-1ms、now-48h、now+5min、now+5min+1ms：超界两项返回event_time_out_of_range且无记录，边界两项可准入；准入未来事件在实际聚合作业时钟到其occurredAt前不计入，到时后才计入。48h内迟到事件仅重算仍具完整原始覆盖的所属日，已关闭/超窗口历史不受任意客户端时间污染；完整覆盖外保留原聚合并标partial/unavailable，不以残片写小或造未来日（E-60）。
en_accept: 1) composition registers only the implemented analytics-aggregate; deploy/cron.nbshiyan calls POST /api/admin/cron/operations every five minutes. Validate fixed keys/Bearer credentials in constant time; reject unknown keys/missing credentials and permit no arbitrary scripts. 2) Real scheduling executes after restart and commits JobState/watermark, with batch at most 500, a 55s deadline and no old-generation overwrite. Stopped cron/failure preserves the last successful watermark and exposes safe NEVER/FAILED/stale-value state; route existence/manual invocation does not justify claiming just updated (E-81, E-84). 3) After browser consent, complete two same-day page visits in the same browser and refresh/retry the same eventId. After the actual job UV stays 1, genuine new visits increase PV and duplicate events do not increase counts (E-44). Dashboard GET does not trigger jobs; M4 registers notification/mail jobs, without future-service imports or empty implementations. 4) In an isolated service with a controlled clock, use the event HTTP entry to submit now-48h-1ms, now-48h, now+5min and now+5min+1ms separately. The two out-of-range inputs return event_time_out_of_range without records, while both exact boundaries can be admitted. An admitted future event is excluded until the actual aggregation-job clock reaches its occurredAt, and counted only afterward. Events arriving within 48h recompute only their day when complete raw coverage remains; arbitrary client timestamps cannot contaminate closed/out-of-window history. Beyond complete coverage preserve the original aggregate and mark partial/unavailable, without reducing counts from fragments or fabricating future days (E-60).
